# TimeWarp.Architecture (template host)

> Agent-first discovery index for this template demo host. Auth is passkey /
> agent-key first — not email/password. Paid power uses x402 (TimeWarp.402);
> free and discovery routes never return HTTP 402.

## Start here

- [Authentication (auth.md)](/auth.md): Humans (passkeys), agents (public keys + scoped bearer tokens), payment posture, and what we deliberately do not do.
- [Home (index.md)](/index.md): Markdown twin of `/`. Also via `Accept: text/markdown` on `/`.
- [robots.txt](/robots.txt): Agent-welcome crawl policy with Content Signals (`ai-train=yes, search=yes, ai-input=yes`).
- [sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml): Public discovery and demo entry points.

## Human auth (browser)

- Passkey registration / sign-in UI: [/Passkeys](/Passkeys), [/Login](/Login)
- WebAuthn ceremony API (anonymous start/complete):
  - `POST /api/identity/passkey/register/options`
  - `POST /api/identity/passkey/register`
  - `POST /api/identity/passkey/authenticate/options`
  - `POST /api/identity/passkey/authenticate`
- Session read: `GET /api/identity/session` (cookie after a completed passkey ceremony)

There is **no** email/password registration form and **no** “create account with email” path.

## Agent auth (no browser)

- Register ECDSA P-256 public key (no human sponsor):
  - `POST /api/identity/agent/register/options`
  - `POST /api/identity/agent/register`
- Issue short-lived scoped opaque bearer token:
  - `POST /api/identity/agent/token/options`
  - `POST /api/identity/agent/token`
- Who am I: `GET /api/identity/agent/me` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (scope `identity:read`)

### Onboarding (preferred)

From a clone of this repo (not available to pure HTTP agents — use the API above):

```text
dotnet run tools/agent-identity-cli/agent.cs -- demo
```

Commands: `keygen`, `register`, `token`, `whoami`, `demo`. Default server: `https://localhost:63611`. Signing uses `AgentKeyProof.BuildSignedData` (TimeWarp.Identity). Manual openssl/curl sequence: kanban task **104-004** Results.

## API surface

- OpenAPI document: [/openapi/v1.json](/openapi/v1.json)
- Scalar UI: [/scalar/v1](/scalar/v1)
- Health: [/api/health](/api/health)

## Protocol discovery (v1 minimal)

Stable well-known paths. Stubs are **honest**: empty MCP tools and no live A2A JSON-RPC task endpoint yet.

| Surface | Path | Notes |
|---------|------|-------|
| MCP Server Card | [/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json](/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json) | Alias: [/.well-known/mcp.json](/.well-known/mcp.json). `capabilities.tools=false`; do not call `/mcp` for tools yet. |
| Agent Skills index | [/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json](/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json) | Live skill-md artifacts (`timewarp-identity`, `timewarp-architecture-discovery`). |
| A2A Agent Card | [/.well-known/agent-card.json](/.well-known/agent-card.json) | Alias: [/.well-known/agent.json](/.well-known/agent.json). Unsigned v1; skills map to REST identity + discovery. |

```bash
curl -sS https://<host>/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
curl -sS https://<host>/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
curl -sS https://<host>/.well-known/agent-card.json
```

## Payment (x402)

- Library: **TimeWarp.402** (challenge / verify / settle; disabled or misconfigured payment → **503**, never 402 on free/discovery paths).
- Host-wired tip jar and metered “pay for capability” demo endpoints are still landing (template waves). Do not invent payment URLs not listed here.
- When paid routes appear, they will be linked from this file and from auth.md.

## Content usage preferences

`ai-train=yes, search=yes, ai-input=yes` — see [robots.txt](/robots.txt).

## Markdown content negotiation

Key HTML pages have static `.md` twins under the site root. Agents can:

1. Fetch the twin URL directly (e.g. `/index.md`, `/auth.md`), or
2. Request the HTML route with `Accept: text/markdown` (home `/` rewrites to `/index.md`).

```bash
curl -sS -H 'Accept: text/markdown' https://<host>/
curl -sS https://<host>/index.md
curl -sS https://<host>/auth.md
```

Browser requests (Accept: text/html) are unchanged — Blazor SPA hosting is not affected.

## Planned agent surfaces (not yet shipped)

- Discoverable x402 tip or meter path for commerce scanners (task 104-020)
- Live streamable-HTTP MCP tools endpoint (card exists as stub until then)
- Full A2A JSON-RPC task protocol + signed Agent Cards

Stubs are better than fiction: do not invent endpoints not linked here.
